any.unavailable: housing deed-restricted or subsidized as affordable housing
dormitory owned and operated by a school or higher education institution
housing under local rent control that restricts annual increases below the state cap
separately alienable property owned by a non-corporate, non-REIT owner with written exemption notice

all.unavailable: owner occupied one of two units as principal residence at start of tenancy, neither an ADU

rules.interaction: Does not apply to housing under local rent control that limits annual increases to less than this cap; it does not expand or limit local rent control authority.
rules.title: Tenant Protection Act rent cap (SB 567 version)
rules.requirement: Rent cannot be raised more than 5% plus local CPI change, or 10%, whichever is lower, in any 12-month period, and no more than twice in that period. New tenancies may start at any rent.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental units not exempt; applies to increases from the lowest rent charged in the prior 12 months; sunset Jan 1, 2030
rules.exemptions: Deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing, dorms, housing under stricter local rent control, housing with certificate of occupancy within 15 years, separately alienable non-corporate owner property with notice, owner-occupied duplex
rules.quoted_span: shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower

notes: Operative 2024-04-01 (SB 567, effective 2024-01-01). Original AB 1482 start 2020-01-01 is not the current version. yields_to lists CA cities with local rent control; consolidator should prune to those with a rule. Sunsets 2030-01-01.
